name: day-82-triton-tc
statement: Every device value is a declared input copied from the public page that its source names, read on 2026-11-26. No value is a measurement, and no NVIDIA GPU ran anything for this lab.

a100-product.title: NVIDIA A100 Tensor Core GPU product page, Specifications table

ampere-blog.title: NVIDIA Ampere Architecture In-Depth, NVIDIA Technical Blog

h100-product.title: NVIDIA H100 Tensor Core GPU product page, Product Specifications table

hopper-blog.title: NVIDIA Hopper Architecture In-Depth, NVIDIA Technical Blog

sparsity.states: The Sparsity feature exploits fine-grained structured sparsity in deep learning networks, doubling the performance of standard Tensor Core operations.

sm_count.states: The A100 is based on GA100 and has 108 SMs.

boost_clock_mhz.states: The comparison table lists a GPU Boost Clock of 1410 MHz for A100.

memory_bandwidth_gb_per_second.states: GPU Memory Bandwidth: 2,039 GB/s for A100 80GB SXM.

fma_per_sm_per_clock.states: The comparison table lists 64 FP32 Cores / SM for A100; each core does one FP32 FMA per clock.
Peak TF32 Tensor TFLOPS 156/312 is half of Peak FP16 Tensor TFLOPS 312/624 at the same clock and SM count, so TF32 runs at half of 1024 dense FMA per clock per SM.

listed_tflops.states: Tensor Float 32 (TF32): 156 TFLOPS | 312 TFLOPS*, * With sparsity.

fma_per_sm_per_clock.states: A100 has four Tensor Cores per SM, which together deliver 1024 dense FP16/FP32 FMA operations per clock.

listed_tflops.states: FP16 Tensor Core: 312 TFLOPS | 624 TFLOPS*, * With sparsity.

fma_per_sm_per_clock.states: Peak BF16 Tensor TFLOPS with FP32 Accumulate 312/624 equals the FP16 row at the same clock and SM count, so BF16 runs at 1024 dense FMA per clock per SM.

listed_tflops.states: BFLOAT16 Tensor Core: 312 TFLOPS | 624 TFLOPS*, * With sparsity.

sm_count.states: The H100 SXM5 GPU has 132 SMs, and the PCIe version has 114 SMs.

boost_clock_mhz.states: The comparison table lists the H100 GPU Boost Clock as Not finalized, and the H100 product page lists no clock.

memory_bandwidth_gb_per_second.states: GPU Memory Bandwidth: 3.35TB/s for H100 SXM.

fma_per_sm_per_clock.states: 128 FP32 CUDA Cores per SM, 16896 FP32 CUDA Cores per GPU.
On a per SM basis, the Tensor Cores deliver 2x the MMA computational rates of the A100 SM on equivalent data types: 2 x 512.

listed_tflops.states: TF32 Tensor Core*: 989 teraFLOPS for H100 SXM, * With sparsity.

fma_per_sm_per_clock.states: On a per SM basis, the Tensor Cores deliver 2x the MMA computational rates of the A100 SM on equivalent data types: 2 x 1024.

listed_tflops.states: FP16 Tensor Core*: 1,979 teraFLOPS for H100 SXM, * With sparsity.

fma_per_sm_per_clock.states: On a per SM basis, the Tensor Cores deliver 2x the MMA computational rates of the A100 SM on equivalent data types: 2 x 1024.

listed_tflops.states: BFLOAT16 Tensor Core*: 1,979 teraFLOPS for H100 SXM, * With sparsity.
